Cellar: +1 Action. Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.
Chapel: Trash up to 4 cards from your hand.
Moat: +2 Cards. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first reveal this from your hand, to be unaffected by it.
Chancellor: +$2. You may immediately put your deck into your discard pile.
Merchant: +1 Card. +1 Action. The first time you play a Silver this turn, +$1.
Vassal: +$2. Discard the top card of your deck. If it's an Action card, you may play it.
Workshop: Gain a card costing up to $4.
Bureaucrat: Gain a Silver onto your deck. Each other player reveals a Victory card from their hand and puts it onto their deck (or reveals a hand with no Victory cards).
Feast: Trash this card. Gain a card costing up to $5.
Gardens: Worth +1VP per 10 cards you have (round down).
Militia: +$2. Each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand.
Moneylender: You may trash a Copper from your hand for +$3.
Poacher: +1 Card. +1 Action. +$1. Discard a card per empty Supply pile.
Remodel: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $2 more than it.
Spy: +1 Card. +1 Action. Each player (including you) reveals the top card of his deck and either discards it or puts it back, your choice.
Thief: Each other player reveals the top 2 cards of his deck.If they revealed any Treasure cards, they trash one of them that you choose. You may gain any or all of these trashed cards. They discard the other revealed cards.
Throne Room: You may play an Action card from your hand twice.
Bandit: Gain a Gold. Each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, trashes a revealed Treasure other than Copper, and discards the rest.
Council Room: +4 Cards. +1 Buy. Each other player draws a card.
Library: Draw until you have 7 cards in hand, skipping any Action cards you choose to; set those aside, discarding them afterwards.
Mine: You may trash a Treasure card from your hand. Gain a Treasure card to your hand costing up to $3 more than it.
Sentry: +1 Card. +1 Action. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Trash and/or discard any number of them. Put the rest back on top in any order.
Witch: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Curse.
Adventurer: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal 2 Treasure cards. Put those Treasure cards into your hand and discard the other revealed cards.
Artisan: Gain a card to your hand costing up to $5.Put a card from your hand onto your deck.
Courtyard: +3 Cards. Put a card from your hand onto your deck.
Lurker: +1 Action. Choose one: Trash an Action card from the Supply; or gain an Action card from the trash.
Pawn: Choose two: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; +$1. The choices must be different.
Secret chamber: Discard any number of cards. +$1 per card discarded. When another player plays an Attack card, you may reveal this from your hand. If you do, +2 Cards, then put 2 cards from your hand on top of your deck.
Masquerade: +2 Cards. Each player with any cards in hand passes one to the next such player to their left, at once. Then you may trash a card from your hand.
Shanty Town: +2 Actions. Reveal your hand. If you have no Action cards in hand, +2 Cards.
Steward: Choose one: +2 Cards; or +$2; or trash 2 cards from your hand.
Swindler: +$2. Each other player trashes the top card of their deck and gains a card with the same cost that you choose.
Wishing well: +1 Card. +1 Action Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If you named it, put it into your hand.
Baron: +1 Buy. You may discard an Estate for +$4. If you don't, gain an Estate.
Conspirator: +$2. If you've played 3 or more Actions this turn (counting this), +1 Card and +1 Action.
Coppersmith: Copper produces an extra $1 this turn.
Diplomat: +2 Cards. If you have 5 or fewer cards in hand (after drawing), +2 Actions. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first reveal this from a hand of 5 or more cards, to draw 2 cards then discard 3.
Ironworks: Gain a card costing up to $1Victory card, +1 Card
Mill: +1 Card. +1 Action. You may discard 2 cards, for +2
Mining Village: +1 Card. +2 Actions You may trash this for +$2.
Scout: +1 Action. Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the revealed Victory cards into your hand. Put the other cards on top of your deck in any order.
Secret passage: +2 Cards. +1 Action Take a card from your hand and put it anywhere in your deck.
Courtier: Reveal a card from your hand. For each type it has (Action, Attack, etc.), choose one: +1 Action; or +1 Buy; or +$3; or gain a Gold. The choices must be different.
Minion: +1 Action. Choose one: +$2; or discard your hand, +4 Cards, and each other player with at least 5 cards in hand discards their hand and draws 4 cards.
Patrol: +3 Cards. Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the Victory cards and Curses into your hand. Put the rest back in any order.
Replace: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $2 more than it. If the gained card is an Action or Treasure, put it onto your deck; if it's a Victory card, each other player gains a Curse.
Saboteur: Each other player reveals cards from the top of his deck until revealing one costing $2 less than it. He discards the other revealed cards.
Torturer: +3 Cards. Each other player either discards 2 cards or gains a Curse to their hand, their choice. (They may pick an option they can't do.)
Trading Post: Trash 2 cards from your hand. If you did, gain a Silver to your hand.
Tribute: The player to your left reveals then discards the top 2 cards of his deck. For each differently named card revealed, if it is an…Action Card, +2 Actions Treasure Card, +$2 Victory Card, +2 Cards.
Upgrade: +1 Card. +1 Action Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing exactly $1 more than it.
Embargo: +$2. Trash this to add an Embargo token to a Supply pile. (For the rest of the game, when a player buys a card from that pile, they gain a Curse.)
Haven: +1 Card. +1 ActionS et aside a card from your hand face down (under this). At the start of your next turn, put it into your hand.
Lighthouse: +1 Action. Now and at the start of your next turn: +$1. While you have this in play, when another player plays an Attack card, it doesn't affect you.
Native Village: +2 Actions. Choose one: Put the top card of your deck face down on your Native Village mat (you may look at those cards at any time); or put all the cards from your mat into your hand.
Pearl Diver: +1 Card. +1 Action. Look at the bottom card of your deck. You may put it on top.
Ambassador: Reveal a card from your hand. Return up to 2 copies of it from your hand to the Supply. Then each other player gains a copy of it.
Lookout: +1 Action. Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Trash one of them. Discard one of them. Put the other one back on top of your deck.
Smugglers: Gain a copy of a card costing up to $6 that the player to your right gained on their last turn.
Caravan: +1 Card. +1 Action. At the start of your next turn, +1 Card.
Cutpurse: +$2. Each other player discards a Copper (or reveals a hand with no Copper).
Island: Put this and a card from your hand onto your Island mat. +2VP
Navigator: +$2. Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Either discard them all, or put them back in any order.
Pirate Ship: Choose one: +$1 per Coin token on your Pirate Ship mat; or each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, trashes one of those Treasures that you choose, and discards the rest, and then if anyone trashed a Treasure you add a Coin token to your Pirate Ship mat.
Sea Hag: Each other player discards the top card of their deck, then gains a Curse onto their deck.
Salvager: +1 Buy. Trash a card from your hand. +$1 it costs.
Treasure Map: Trash this and a Treasure Map from your hand. If you trashed two Treasure Maps, gain 4 Golds onto your deck.
Explorer: You may reveal a Province from your hand. If you do, gain a Gold to your hand. If you don't, gain a Silver to your hand.
Ghost Ship: +2 Cards. Each other player with 4 or more cards in hand puts cards from their hand onto their deck until they have 3 cards in hand.
Merchant Ship: Now and at the start of your next turn: +$2.
Outpost: If this is the first time you played an Outpost this turn, and the previous turn wasn't yours, then take an extra turn after this one, and you only draw 3 cards for your next hand.
Tactician: If you have at least one card in hand, discard your hand, and at the start of your next turn, +5 Cards, +1 Action, and +1 Buy.
Treasury: +1 Card. +1 Action. +$1. When you discard this from play, if you didn't buy a Victory card this turn, you may put this onto your deck.
Wharf: Now and at the start of your next turn: +2 Cards and +1 Buy.
Transmute: Trash a card from your hand. If it is an…Action card, gain a DuchyTreasure card, gain a TransmuteVictory card, gain a Gold
Vineyard: Worth +1VP per 3 Action cards you have (round down).
Herbalist: +1 Buy. +$1. When you discard this from play, you may put one of your Treasures from play onto your deck.
Apothecary: +1 Card. +1 Action. Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the Coppers and Potions into your hand. Put the rest back in any order.
Scrying Pool: +1 Action. Each player (including you) reveals the top card of their deck and either discards it or puts it back, your choice. Then reveal cards from your deck until revealing one that isn't an Action. Put all of those revealed cards into your hand.
University: +2 Actions. You may gain an Action card costing up to $5.
Alchemist: +2 Cards. +1 Action. When you discard this from play, if you have a Potion in play, you may put this onto your deck.
Familiar: +1 Card. +1 Action. Each other player gains a Curse.
Philosopher's Stone: When you play this, count your deck and discard pile. Worth $1 per 5 cards total between them (round down).
Golem: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal 2 Action cards other than Golems. Discard the other cards, then play the Action cards in either order.
Apprentice: +1 Action. Trash a card from your hand. +1 Card per P in its cost.
Possession: The player to your left takes an extra turn after this one, in which you can see all cards they can and make all decisions for them. Any cards or DBT they would gain on that turn, you gain instead; any cards of theirs that are trashed are set aside and put in their discard pile at end of turn.
Loan: +$1. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Treasure. Discard it or trash it. Discard the other cards.
Trade Route: +1 Buy. Trash a card from your hand. +$1 per Coin token on the Trade Route mat. Setup: Add a Coin token to each Victory Supply pile; move that token to the Trade Route mat when a card is gained from that pile.
Watchtower: Draw until you have 6 cards in hand. When you gain a card, you may reveal this from your hand, to either trash that card or put it onto your deck.
Bishop: +$1. +1VP Trash a card from your hand. +1VP per $2 it costs (round down). Each other player may trash a card from their hand.
Talisman: +$4. or less, gain a copy of it.
City: +1 Card. +2 Actions. If there are one or more empty Supply piles, +1 Card. If there are two or more, +1 Buy and +$1
Contraband: +$3. +1 Buy The player to your left names a card. You can't buy that card this turn.
Counting House: Look through your discard pile, reveal any number of Coppers from it, and put them into your hand.
Mint: You may reveal a Treasure card from your hand. Gain a copy of it. When you buy this, trash all Treasures you have in play.
Mountebank: +$2. Each other player may discard a Curse. If they don't, they gain a Curse and a Copper.
Rabble: +3 Cards. Each other player reveals the top 3 cards of their deck, discards the revealed Actions and Treasures, and puts the rest back in any order they choose.
Royal Seal: +$2. While you have this in play, when you gain a card, you may put that card onto your deck.
Vault: +2 Cards. Discard any number of cards for +$1 each. Each other player may discard 2 cards, to draw a card.
Venture: +$1. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Treasure. Discard the other cards. Play that Treasure.
Goons: +1 Buy. +$2. Each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand. While you have this in play, when you buy a card, +1VP.
Grand Market: +1 Card. +1 Action. +1 Buy. +$2. You can't buy this if you have any Coppers in play.
Hoard: +$2. While you have this in play, when you buy a Victory card, gain a Gold.
Bank: +$1. per Treasure card you have in play (counting this).
Expand: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $3 more than it.
Forge: Trash any number of cards from your hand. Gain a card with cost exactly equal to the total cost in $ of the trashed cards.
King's Court: You may play an Action card from your hand three times.
Peddler: +1 Card. +1 Action. +$1. During a player's Buy phase, this costs $2 less per Action card they have in play.
Hamlet: +1 Card. +1 Action. You may discard a card for +1 Action. You may discard a card for +1 Buy.
Stonemason: Trash a card from your hand. Gain 2 cards each costing less than it. When you buy this, you may overpay for it. If you do, gain 2 Action cards each costing the amount you overpaid.
Doctor: Name a card. Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Trash the matches. Put the rest back in any order. When you buy this, you may overpay for it. For each $1 you overpaid, look at the top card of your deck; trash it, discard it, or put it back.
Fortune Teller: +$2. Each other player reveals cards from the top of their deck until they reveal a Victory card or a Curse. They put it on top and discard the rest.
Advisor: +1 Action. Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. The player to your left chooses one of them. Discard that card and put the rest into your hand.
Farming Village: +2 Actions. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Treasure or Action card. Put that card into your hand and discard the rest.
Herald: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an Action, play it. When you buy this, you may overpay for it. For each $1 you overpaid, look through your discard pile and put a card from it onto your deck.
Horse Traders: +1 Buy. +$3. Discard 2 cards. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first set this aside from your hand. If you do, then at the start of your next turn, +1 Card and return this to your hand.
Plaza: +1 Card. +2 Actions You may discard a Treasure for +1 Coffers.
Remake: Do this twice: Trash a card from your hand, then gain a card costing exactly $1 more than it.
Taxman: You may trash a Treasure from your hand. Each other player with 5 or more cards in hand discards a copy of it (or reveals they can't). Gain a Treasure onto your deck costing up to $3 more than it.
Tournament: +1 Action. Each player may reveal a Province from their hand. If you do, discard it and gain any Prize (from the Prize pile) or a Duchy, onto your deck. If no-one else does, +1 Card and +$1.
Young Witch: +2 Cards. Discard 2 cards. Each other player may reveal a Bane card from their hand; if they don't, they gain a Curse. Setup: Add an extra Kingdom card pile costing $3 to the Supply. Cards from that pile are Bane cards.
Baker: +1 Card. +1 Action +1 Coffers Setup: Each player gets +1 Coffers.
Butcher: +2 Coffers. You may trash a card from your hand. If you do, remove any number of tokens from your Coffers and gain a card, costing up to the cost of the trashed card plus $1 per token removed.
Harvest: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck, then discard them. +$1 per differently named card revealed.
Horn of Plenty: When you play this, gain a card costing up to $1 per differently named card you have in play (counting this). If it's a Victory card, trash this.
Hunting Party: +1 Card. +1 Action. Reveal your hand. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal one that isn't a copy of one in your hand. Put it into your hand and discard the rest.
Jester: +$2. Each other player discards the top card of their deck. If it's a Victory card they gain a Curse; otherwise they gain a copy of the discarded card or you do, your choice.
Journeyman: Name a card. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal 3 cards without that name. Put those cards into your hand and discard the rest.
Merchant Guild: +1 Buy. +$1. While this is in play, when you buy a card, +1 Coffers.
Soothsayer: Gain a Gold. Each other player gains a Curse, and if they did, draws a card.
Fairgrounds: Worth +2VP per 5 differently named cards you have (round down).
Crossroads: Reveal your hand. +1 Card per Victory card revealed. If this is the first time you played a Crossroads this turn, +3 Actions .
Duchess: +$2. Each player (including you) looks at the top card of their deck and may discard it. In games using this, when you gain a Duchy, you may gain a Duchess.
Fool's Gold: If this is the first time you played a Fool's Gold this turn, +$4. When another player gains a Province, you may trash this from your hand, to gain a Gold onto your deck.
Develop: Trash a card from your hand. Gain two cards onto your deck, with one costing exactly $1 less than it, in either order.
Oracle: Each player (including you) reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, and discards them or puts them back, your choice (they choose the order). Then, +2 Cards.
Scheme: +1 Card. +1 Action. This turn, you may put one of your Action cards onto your deck when you discard it from play.
Tunnel: +2VP. When you discard this other than during Clean-up, you may reveal it to gain a Gold.
Jack of All Trades: Gain a Silver. Look at the top card of your deck; you may discard it. Draw until you have 5 cards in hand. You may trash a non-Treasure card from your hand.
Noble Brigand: +$1. Each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, trashes a revealed Silver or Gold you choose, discards the rest, and gains a Copper if they didn't reveal a Treasure. You gain the trashed cards. When you buy this, do its attack.
Nomad Camp: +1 Buy. +$2 This is gained onto your deck (instead of to your discard pile).
Silk Road: Worth +1VP for every 4 Victory cards you have (round down).
Spice Merchant: You may trash a Treasure from your hand to choose one: +2 Cards and +1 Action; or +1 Buy and +$2.
Trader: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a Silver per $1 it costs. When you gain a card, you may reveal this from your hand, to exchange the card for a Silver.
Cache: +$3. When you gain this, gain 2 Coppers.
Cartographer: +1 Card. +1 Action. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Discard any number of them, then put the rest back in any order.
Embassy: +5 Cards. Discard 3 cards. When you gain this, each other player gains a Silver.
Haggler: +$2. While you have this in play, when you buy a card, gain a cheaper non-Victory card.
Highway: +1 Card. +1 Action. While this is in play, cards cost $1 less.
Ill-Gotten Gains: +$1. You may gain a Copper to your hand. When you gain this, each other player gains a Curse.
Inn: +2 Cards. +2 Actions Discard 2 cards. When you gain this, look through your discard pile, reveal any number of Action cards from it (which can include this), and shuffle them into your deck.
Mandarin: +$3. Put a card from your hand onto your deck. When you gain this, put all Treasures you have in play onto your deck in any order.
Margrave: +3 Cards. +1 Buy Each other player draws a card, then discards down to 3 cards in hand.
Stables: You may discard a Treasure, for +3 Cards and +1 Action.
Border Village: +1 Card. +2 Actions When you gain this, gain a cheaper card.
Farmland: +2VP. When you buy this, trash a card from your hand and gain a card costing exactly +$2 more than it.
Beggar: Gain 3 Coppers to your hand. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first discard this to gain 2 Silvers, putting one onto your deck.
Squire: +$1. Choose one: +2 Actions ; or +2 Buy s; or gain a Silver. When you trash this, gain an Attack card.
Vagrant: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Curse, Ruins, Shelter, or Victory card, put it into your hand.
Forager: +1 Action. +1 Buy. Trash a card from your hand, then +$1 per differently named Treasure in the trash.
Hermit: Look through your discard pile. You may trash a non-Treasure card from your discard pile or hand. Gain a card costing up to $3. When you discard this from play, if you didn't buy any cards this turn, trash this and gain a Madman from the Madman pile.
Market Square: +1 Card. +1 Action +1 Buy When one of your cards is trashed, you may discard this from your hand to gain a Gold.
Sage: +1 Action. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal one costing $3 or more. Put that card into your hand and discard the rest.
Storeroom: +1 Buy. Discard any number of cards, then draw that many. Then discard any number of cards for +$1 each.
Urchin: +1 Card. +1 Action Each other player discards down to 4 cards in hand. When you play another Attack card with this in play, you may first trash this, to gain a Mercenary from the Mercenary pile.
Armory: Gain a card onto your deck costing up to $4.
Death Cart: You may trash this or an Action card from your hand, for +$5. When you gain this, gain 2 Ruins.
Feodum: Worth +1VP per 3 Silvers you have (round down). When you trash this, gain 3 Silvers.
Fortress: +1 Card. +2 Actions When you trash this, put it into your hand.
Ironmonger: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck; you may discard it. Either way, if it is an…Action card, +1 Action Treasure card, +$1 Victory card, +1 Card
Marauder: Gain a Spoils from the Spoils pile. Each other player gains a Ruins.
Procession: You may play a non-Duration Action card from your hand twice. Trash it. Gain an Action card costing exactly $1 more than it.
Rats: +1 Card. +1 Action Gain a Rats. Trash a card from your hand other than a Rats (or reveal a hand of all Rats). When you trash this, +1 Card.
Scavenger: +$2. You may put your deck into your discard pile. Look through your discard pile and put one card from it onto your deck.
Wandering Minstrel: +1 Card. +2 Actions Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Put the Action cards back in any order and discard the rest.
Band of Misfits: Play a non-Command Action card from the Supply that costs less than this, leaving it there.
Bandit Camp: +1 Card. +2 Actions Gain a Spoils from the Spoils pile.
Catacombs: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Choose one: Put them into your hand; or discard them and +3 Cards. When you trash this, gain a cheaper card.
Count: Choose one: Discard 2 cards; or put a card from your hand onto your deck; or gain a Copper. Choose one: +$3; or trash your hand; or gain a Duchy.
Counterfeit: +$1. +1 Buy When you play this, you may play a Treasure from your hand twice. If you do, trash that Treasure.
Cultist: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Ruins. You may play a Cultist from your hand. When you trash this, +3 Cards.
Graverobber: Choose one: Gain a card from the trash costing from $3 more than it.
Junk Dealer: +1 Card. +1 Action +$1.Trash a card from your hand.
Mystic: +1 Action. +$2. Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If you named it, put it into your hand.
Pillage: Trash this. If you did, gain 2 Spoils, and each other player with 5 or more cards in hand reveals their hand and discards a card that you choose.
Rebuild: +1 Action. Name a card. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Victory card you did not name. Discard the rest, trash the Victory card, and gain a Victory card costing up to $3 more than it.
Altar: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $5.
Hunting Grounds: +4 Cards. When you trash this, gain a Duchy or 3 Estates.
Coin of the realm: +$1. When you play this, put it on your Tavern mat. Directly after you finish playing an Action card, you may call this, for +2 Actions .
Page: +1 Card. +1 Action When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Treasure Hunter.
Peasant: +1 Buy. +$1. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Soldier.
Ratcatcher: +1 Card. +1 Action Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this, to trash a card from your hand.
Raze: +1 Action. Trash this or a card from your hand. Look at one card from the top of your deck per $1 the trashed card costs. Put one of them into your hand and discard the rest.
Amulet: Now and at the start of your next turn, choose one: +$1; or trash a card from your hand; or gain a Silver.
Caravan Guard: +1 Card. +1 Action At the start of your next turn, +$1. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first play this from your hand.(+1 Action has no effect if it's not your turn.)
Dungeon: +1 Action. Now and at the start of your next turn: +2 Cards, then discard 2 cards.
Gear: +2 Cards. Set aside up to 2 cards from your hand face down (under this). At the start of your next turn, put them into your hand.
Guide: +1 Card. +1 Action Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this, to discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
Duplicate: Put this on your Tavern mat. When you gain a card costing up to $6, you may call this, to gain a copy of that card.
Magpie: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Treasure, put it into your hand. If it's an Action or Victory card, gain a Magpie.
Messenger: +1 Buy. +$4, and each other player gains a copy of it.
Miser: Choose one: Put a Copper from your hand onto your Tavern mat; or +$1 per Copper on your Tavern mat.
Port: +1 Card. +2 Actions When you buy this, gain another Port.
Ranger: +1 Buy. Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face up, +5 Cards.
Distant Lands: Put this on your Tavern mat. Worth +4VP if on your Tavern mat at the end of the game (otherwise worth +0VP).
Giant: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face down, +$6, and otherwise discards it and gains a Curse.
Haunted Woods: Until your next turn, when any other player buys a card, they put their hand onto their deck in any order. At the start of your next turn: +3 Cards
Lost City: +2 Cards. +2 Actions When you gain this, each other player draws a card.
Relic: +$2. When you play this, each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.
Royal Carriage: +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. Directly after you finish playing an Action card, if it's still in play, you may call this, to replay that Action.
Swamp Hag: Until your next turn, when any other player buys a card, they gain a Curse. At the start of your next turn: +$3.
Treasure Trove: +$2. When you play this, gain a Gold and a Copper.
Wine Merchant: +$2. unspent, you may discard this from your Tavern mat.
Hireling: At the start of each of your turns for the rest of the game: +1 Card(This stays in play.)
Engineer: Gain a card costing up to $4.
City Quarter: +2 Actions. Reveal your hand. +1 Card per Action card revealed.
Overlord: Play a non-Command Action card from the Supply costing up to $5, leaving it there.
Royal Blacksmith: +5 Cards. Reveal your hand; discard the Coppers.
Chariot Race: +1 Action. Reveal the top card of your deck and put it into your hand. The player to your left reveals the top card of their deck. If your card costs more, +1VP.
Enchantress: Until your next turn, the first time each other player plays an Action card on their turn, they get +1 Card and +1 Action instead of following its instructions.At the start of your next turn, +2 Cards.
Farmers' Market: +1 Buy. If there are +4VP or more on the Farmers' Market Supply pile, take them and trash this. Otherwise, add +1VP to the pile and then +$1 per +1VP on the pile.
Sacrifice: Trash a card from your hand. If it's an Action card, +2 Cards, +2 Actions; Treasure card, +$2; Victory Card, +2VP
Temple: +1VP. Trash from 1 to 3 differently named cards from your hand. Add +1VP to the Temple Supply pile. When you gain this, take the VP from the Temple Supply pile.
Villa: +2 Actions. +1 Buy +$1 When you gain this, put it into your hand, +1 Action, and if it's your Buy phase return to your Action phase.
Archive: +1 Action. Set aside the top 3 cards of your deck face down (you may look at them). Now and at the start of your next two turns, put one into your hand.
Charm: When you play this, choose one: +1 Buy and +$2; or the next time you buy a card this turn, you may also gain a differently named card with the same cost.
